race.description: Andy Birrell Loves Tassie Racing Hcp (C3)
race.comment: ALFARINO (3) has resumed from his spell in terrific order, winning 2 races on the bounce from as many starts this season. He skips a grade to be here and will carry 2kg less. The hat-trick beckons. BENEFITSOFMINE (2) wound up late as the favourite when finishing third here 3 weeks ago, following on from an easy win before that on this track. He is in a good space and can take this out. OZONICA (1) was a solid runner-up when racing back on the turf here 3 weeks ago, and from another handy gate, he can figure in the top 3 again. ARTILLERY FIRE (4) had an excuse for a modest run fresh up, and she will improve with that run under her belt. She slots into the pole position and is well worth each-way consideration. DIAMOND INDARUF (6) has been mixing her for on wet tracks in 3 starts this season and was only beaten by a nose here a fortnight ago. A firmer surface can help her, and having Anthony Darmanin in the saddle is a positive. Each way.
